task: Read-only inventory of C_LOC integration and event-generation diagnostics, compared with C_GLB.

status.C_LOC: Integration completed; event generation interrupted by user (KeyboardInterrupt), 22 completed generation jobs out of 103. No combined events file, no shower yet.
status.C_GLB: One million events generated; comparison covers integration and generation logs only.

deduplication.rule: For each job directory, retain log_MINT*.txt archives. Exclude log.txt whenever any log_MINT*.txt sibling exists. Otherwise retain log.txt, including unfinished generation jobs.
deduplication.reason: MG5 keeps current log.txt and copies it to a log_MINT<stage>.txt archive on stage completion; counting both duplicates completed stages.
deduplication.limitations: Partial log.txt files can contain diagnostics but lack end-of-job rejection totals. Completed-stage sums therefore omit unfinished job rejection totals. Counts are diagnostic lines, not necessarily unique sampled points; several components and two calls can warn for one point.

definitions.completed_stage: A retained log containing the Detailed CPU timing sampled-of integration-points line.
definitions.integration_points: Final integer in the sampled-of integration-points report; includes folded MC integrand evaluations, not generated events or just Born phase-space points.
definitions.rejection_totals: End-of-job counters printed by driver_mintMC.f, independent of throttled individual warning lines.
definitions.completed_generation_efficiency: Sum(events generated novi + virt) / sum(another call to the function) across finished MINT2 logs.
definitions.uncertainty: Rejection frequency does not bound omitted cross-section contributions or establish a physics bias.
